name: Pospischil 2008 regular-spiking (RS) cortical cell
citation: Pospischil M, Toledo-Rodriguez M, Monier C, Piwkowska Z, Bal T, Fregnac Y, Markram H, Destexhe A (2008). Minimal Hodgkin-Huxley type models for different classes of cortical and thalamic neurons. Biol Cybern 99(4-5):427-441. doi:10.1007/s00422-008-0263-8
expected_behavior: Single compartment; Na, Kd, IM (slow K) and leak. Shipped OMV reference: 5 spikes with lengthening intervals under a 0.75 nA step (expected spike-frequency adaptation; to confirm by simulation).
inclusion_reason: Pilot fixture 1: adapting regular spiking; MIT; OMV-tested; validates with jnml and libNeuroML

name: Pospischil 2008 low-threshold-spiking (LTS) cell
citation: Pospischil M, Toledo-Rodriguez M, Monier C, Piwkowska Z, Bal T, Fregnac Y, Markram H, Destexhe A (2008). Minimal Hodgkin-Huxley type models for different classes of cortical and thalamic neurons. Biol Cybern 99(4-5):427-441. doi:10.1007/s00422-008-0263-8
expected_behavior: Single compartment; adds T-type Ca (IT, custom LEMS gate types) and a Ca pool. Expected low-threshold burst onset and post-inhibitory rebound (rebound unverified). Late spike times are strongly dt-sensitive under forward Euler (pilot dt probe).
inclusion_reason: Pilot fixture 2: T-current / rebound behaviour; valid under jnml -validate (fails strict libNeuroML XSD because of custom ComponentTypes)

name: Pospischil 2008 fast-spiking (FS) cell
citation: Pospischil M, Toledo-Rodriguez M, Monier C, Piwkowska Z, Bal T, Fregnac Y, Markram H, Destexhe A (2008). Minimal Hodgkin-Huxley type models for different classes of cortical and thalamic neurons. Biol Cybern 99(4-5):427-441. doi:10.1007/s00422-008-0263-8
expected_behavior: Single compartment; Na/Kd/leak; regular non-adapting tonic firing expected.
inclusion_reason: Correlated with RS/LTS (same paper and channel files); candidate for the full study only

name: Pospischil 2008 intrinsically bursting (IB) cell
citation: Pospischil M, Toledo-Rodriguez M, Monier C, Piwkowska Z, Bal T, Fregnac Y, Markram H, Destexhe A (2008). Minimal Hodgkin-Huxley type models for different classes of cortical and thalamic neurons. Biol Cybern 99(4-5):427-441. doi:10.1007/s00422-008-0263-8
expected_behavior: Single compartment; adds high-threshold Ca (IL); bursting-type onset labelled IB (unverified). Shipped step outlasts the simulation.
inclusion_reason: Correlated with RS/LTS; candidate for the full study only

name: NeuroML2 single-compartment Hodgkin-Huxley example cell
citation: Hodgkin AL, Huxley AF (1952). A quantitative description of membrane current and its application to conduction and excitation in nerve. J Physiol 117(4):500-544. doi:10.1113/jphysiol.1952.sp004764 (NeuroML2 teaching implementation)
expected_behavior: Classic HH squid axon kinetics on a 1000 um2 soma; regular tonic firing; no adaptation or rebound currents.
inclusion_reason: Independent source; fast smoke-test fixture; LGPL obligations for redistributed mutants to be decided

name: Wang and Buzsaki 1996 hippocampal interneuron
citation: Wang X-J, Buzsaki G (1996). Gamma oscillation by synaptic inhibition in a hippocampal interneuronal network model. J Neurosci 16(20):6402-6413. doi:10.1523/jneurosci.16-20-06402.1996
expected_behavior: Single compartment; instantaneous Na activation (custom gate type); fast tonic non-adapting firing.
inclusion_reason: EXCLUDED from the primary study (D-051): its own cell file fails NeuroML v2.3.1 validation - jnml: "cvc-complex-type.3.2.2: Attribute 'type' is not allowed to appear in element 'gateHHrates'" (WangBuzsaki.cell.nml line 10, type=gateHHratesInstantaneous; the network file passes and libNeuroML strict passes). Including it would need a model-specific schema exception or a manual repair that changes the representation of the instantaneous sodium activation gate; it is not repaired. Provenance: OpenSourceBrain/WangBuzsaki1996 @ c532284492c3e421a7f8e88b3090af8ffee8cf6a, hash-verified snapshot; licence MIT (NeuroML2 directory), verified at that commit. Execution is fine (shipped harness runs, 10 spikes; rheobase 0.00017 nA). Potential exploratory use: a prespecified sensitivity analysis with the baseline-error exception, reported separately and never pooled. Packet: docs/WANG_BUZSAKI_DECISION_PACKET.md
